IG_UI.json.IGUI_TOC_SW_Self: You are going to operate on yourself.
IG_UI.json.IGUI_TOC_SW_Missing_Tourniquet: no tourniquet on that side: heavy bleeding
IG_UI.json.IGUI_TOC_SW_Missing_Disinfect: no alcohol or disinfectant: the wound starts dirty
IG_UI.json.IGUI_TOC_SW_Missing_Incision: no blade: the saw tears the flesh
IG_UI.json.IGUI_TOC_SW_Missing_Bone: no saw or axe at hand
IG_UI.json.IGUI_TOC_SW_Missing_Stitches: no needle and thread: the stump will bleed for longer
IG_UI.json.IGUI_TOC_SW_Knows: You know how a field amputation is done.
IG_UI.json.IGUI_TOC_SW_NoKnowledge: You have never done this. A Field Amputation Guide would help.
IG_UI.json.IGUI_TOC_SW_Warn_OneHanded: You are working with one hand.
IG_UI.json.IGUI_TOC_SW_Warn_Self: Operating on yourself: you may faint half way through.
IG_UI.json.IGUI_TOC_SW_Warn_Scream: The patient will scream (heard %1 tiles away).
IG_UI.json.IGUI_TOC_SW_RiskUnknown: You could not say how risky this is.
IG_UI.json.IGUI_TOC_Surgery_Result_1: The %1 is gone. It went badly: the stump is a mess.
IG_UI.json.IGUI_TOC_Surgery_Result_2: The %1 is gone. Something tore: the stump is bleeding hard.
IG_UI.json.IGUI_TOC_Cure_late: It was too late. The fever is still there.
IG_UI.json.IGUI_TOC_Cure_doomed: The bite that matters is somewhere else.
IG_UI.json.IGUI_TOC_Cure_none: There was no infection to begin with.
IG_UI.json.IGUI_TOC_ProsthesisWorn: The prosthesis is about to give out.
IG_UI.json.IGUI_TOC_Sepsis_Start: The stump is hot and swollen.
IG_UI.json.IGUI_TOC_Sepsis_Bad: Fever. The stump stinks. Antibiotics, now.
IG_UI.json.IGUI_TOC_PhantomPain: The limb that is not there hurts.
IG_UI.json.IGUI_TOC_NeedCrutch: I cannot walk like this. I need a crutch or a prosthesis.
IG_UI.json.IGUI_TOC_Crawling: No legs. All I can do is crawl.
IG_UI.json.IGUI_TOC_HookCantHold: I cannot hold that with a hook.
IG_UI.json.IGUI_TOC_NoHandForThat: I have no hand for that.
IG_UI.json.IGUI_TOC_Symptom_2: I am sweating and my wound burns.
IG_UI.json.IGUI_TOC_Symptom_4: I can barely stand. It is in my blood.
IG_UI.json.IGUI_TOC_Diag_infected: This wound is infected with the Knox virus.
IG_UI.json.IGUI_TOC_Diag_infected_Maybe: This does not look good. Probably infected.
IG_UI.json.IGUI_TOC_Diag_clean_Maybe: It looks all right, I think.
IG_UI.json.IGUI_TOC_SawSputters: It sputters and dies. Pull again.
IG_UI.json.IGUI_TOC_SawNoFuel: The tank is empty: refuel it with petrol.
IG_UI.json.IGUI_TOC_SawStalled: The chainsaw runs dry and stalls.
IG_UI.json.IGUI_TOC_SawArmBusy: Your right hand is a chainsaw.

Sandbox.json.Sandbox_TOC_CureWindow_tooltip: Amputating while the Knox infection is below this percentage always cures it. Default 20.
Sandbox.json.Sandbox_TOC_LateGambleWindow: Late gamble window (percent of infection progress)
Sandbox.json.Sandbox_TOC_LateGambleWindow_tooltip: Between the cure window and this value the cure becomes a gamble that gets worse every hour. 0 disables the gamble.
Sandbox.json.Sandbox_TOC_ShowSymptoms_tooltip: Chills, sweat and fever messages as the infection advances. They are the only hint you get.
Sandbox.json.Sandbox_TOC_DiagnosisMinDoctor: First Aid level needed to examine a wound
Sandbox.json.Sandbox_TOC_DiagnosisMinDoctor_tooltip: Right-click a bite or scratch in the health panel to get a (fallible) opinion. The Field Amputation Guide also allows it.
Sandbox.json.Sandbox_TOC_RevealOutcome: Reveal the outcome right after the surgery
Sandbox.json.Sandbox_TOC_RevealOutcome_tooltip: Off: you find out whether you were in time the hard way.
Sandbox.json.Sandbox_TOC_SurgeryRiskMultiplier_toolti: Scales the chance of a rough or botched amputation. 0 makes every surgery clean.
Sandbox.json.Sandbox_TOC_ScreamRadius_tooltip: How far a patient without anaesthesia is heard. Zombies will come.
Sandbox.json.Sandbox_TOC_DropSeveredLimbs: Drop the severed limb on the floor
Sandbox.json.Sandbox_TOC_EnableLegAmputations_tooltip: Feet, lower legs and thighs can be amputated. Walking then needs a crutch or a prosthetic leg.
Sandbox.json.Sandbox_TOC_SepsisEnabled_tooltip: A dirty stump gets infected (vanilla wound infection), causes fever and can kill. Clean it with alcohol and take antibiotics.
Sandbox.json.Sandbox_TOC_ConvalescenceDays_tooltip: Days of weakness, hunger and tiredness after an amputation.
Sandbox.json.Sandbox_TOC_CarryPenalty: Carry weight penalty without a hand
Sandbox.json.Sandbox_TOC_ProsthesisWear_tooltip: Every action wears the prosthesis; repair it with glue, tape, welding rods or screws before it breaks.
Sandbox.json.Sandbox_TOC_ZombieCrawlerOnLegHit: Zombies that lose a leg become crawlers
Sandbox.json.Sandbox_TOC_SleepingPillAnesthesia_toolt: How much sleeping pills can count towards anaesthesia during surgery, in percent (0 = they do not count). Painkillers count up to 60 and alcohol up to 50.
Sandbox.json.Sandbox_TOC_SelfAmputationHigh: Self-amputation above the elbow and knee
Sandbox.json.Sandbox_TOC_SelfAmputationHigh_tooltip: Lets a survivor cut off their own upper arm or thigh. Much more likely to fail or to faint halfway.

Tooltip.json.Tooltip_TOC_CantSelfHigh: You cannot cut that high on yourself. Somebody else has to do it.
Tooltip.json.Tooltip_TOC_NeedDoctor: Needs First Aid level %1, or the Field Amputation Guide

UI.json.UI_trait_Amputee_Hand_R_desc: You lost your right hand before all this. The stump has healed.
UI.json.UI_trait_Amputee_ForeArm_R_desc: You lost your right forearm before all this. The stump has healed.
UI.json.UI_trait_Amputee_UpperArm_R_desc: You lost your whole right arm before all this. No prosthesis can be fitted.
UI.json.UI_trait_Amputee_Foot_desc: You lost your left foot before all this. You will need a crutch or a prosthetic leg to move.
UI.json.UI_trait_Amputee_LowerLeg_desc: You lost your left leg below the knee before all this. You will need a crutch or a prosthetic leg to move.
UI.json.UI_trait_Amputee_Foot_R_desc: You lost your right foot before all this. You will need a crutch or a prosthetic leg to move.
UI.json.UI_trait_Amputee_LowerLeg_R_desc: You lost your right leg below the knee before all this. You will need a crutch or a prosthetic leg to move.
